Case reference: 2014004372.CaseDesc: Patrick-Jean De Loppinot was last seen on September 11, 2003, at a friend's residence in Laval, Quebec. Patrick-Jean was supposed to go home that evening but never arrived. He was driving a black 1990 Volkswagen Jetta registered in Québec. At the time of his disappearance, Patrick-Jean lived with family in Longueuil, Quebec.

Case reference: 2024016877.CaseDesc: Nakita Harris, also known by her middle name "Jade," was last seen on October 2, 2023, in Regina, Saskatchewan. Her family and friends have not heard from her since November 2023. There is no evidence to suggest Nakita is the victim of foul play, however, the authorities and her family want to locate her to ensure her safety.

Case reference: 2016070415.CaseDesc: On December 2, 2016, Houda Doumi left Canada with her two children, Zineb and Rayan Lahrim and connected at the John F. Kennedy Airport in New York City, USA, where they then travelled on to Cairo, Egypt. It is believed that Houda and the children are actually in the United Arab Emirates.

Case reference: 2024001594.CaseDesc: Alex Marko was seen for the last time on December 5, 2023 in Winnipeg, Manitoba. He is known for using housing resources for the homeless.

Case reference: 2007002499.CaseDesc: Aju Chukwudiebere Iroaga, was last seen on May 15, 2006 at 4:30 p.m. by coworkers at Domtar Rd 100, sometimes called Danny Lake Rd, in Bayfield Twp, Lake Rampike. He left his place of employment, which is a local tree planting site, on foot.

Case reference: 2012020064.CaseDesc: On June 24, 2000, Irma Murdock was seen for the last time in Winnipeg, Manitoba. It is believed that Irma may have travelled to Vancouver, British Colombia.

Case reference: 2025062821.CaseDesc: Amarjit Jeerh boarded a plane departing from Calgary, Alberta on May 22, 1984 for Delhi, India. She has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014003363.CaseDesc: At 2:00 a.m., on April 21, 1992, Hilda Beaudoin and her brother left the Beagle Lounge in Mary's Harbour, Newfoundland Labrador. They embarked on a single snowmobile to ride across the sea ice near coastal waters in efforts to return to St. Lewis, Newfoundland and Labrador. Neither Hilda or her brother arrived at their destination. Snowmobile tracks were discovered leading into open water near St. Lewis where the snowmobile and Hilda's brother's body were later recovered from the ocean waters.

Case reference: 2025070913.CaseDesc: On December 28, 2025, Brian Sicard was reported missing by his family to the Chilliwack RCMP in British Columbia. We have not had any communication or sighting of Brian since December 26, 2025. It has been confirmed that Brian drives a brown 2006 Chevrolet Cobalt, which is also currently missing. Despite exhaustive efforts, neither Brian nor his vehicle have been located, and there have been no confirmed sightings.

Case reference: 2013000041.CaseDesc: David Luborsky was reported missing on the 4th of November 2010. David was last seen leaving the Parklane Residence which is situated at 1095 Merivale Road, in the City of Ottawa.

Right Side Of Neck, Clover leaf

Case reference: 2012020058.CaseDesc: Roger Keesick was last seen in Winnipeg, Manitoba in May 1986.  His family believed he was travelling to northern Manitoba for the summer months to work at a fishing lodge.  Roger was expected back in October.  He did not return in the Fall and his family reported him missing. It was later discovered that he had never made it there.

Scar: Report only indicates "body scars"; no location indicated

Case reference: 2014004643.CaseDesc: On July 28, 2002, Carol Tuks was last seen while exiting a Greyhound bus in Red Deer, Alberta.

Shirt: Black, Blue, Size Small or Medium; unknown style

Case reference: 2021017120.CaseDesc: On May 2, 2021, Nathan Zuk was reported missing by family when he did not return from a boat trip. In mid-December 2020, Nathan departed from his family residence in Whaletown, British Columbia, in a 14-foot skiff rowboat. He was thought to be en route to a location near the Pryce Channel, Deer Passage and or Toba Inlet in British Columbia. Despite having left with supplies that would have lasted him for several months, Nathan had backcountry experience and would have eventually returned. Nathan had medical and some mobility issues.

Hair: Brown, Wavy, Greying at temples, may have longer hair and a beard
Jacket: Leather, Black, Black leather jacket with a grey hood (zip up style)
Other: Middle Back, Curvature in the spine causing mobility issues

Case reference: 2014003230.CaseDesc: James McGrath was reported missing on May 31, 2001, by family members.  At the time of his disappearance he was residing near Patrick's Cove, Newfoundland & Labrador.  James lived alone, and was last seen walking on the roadway approximately seven days before his disappearance.

Case reference: 2018061754.CaseDesc: Jessica Malouf-Pelletier left her parents' home in St.-Sulpice, Quebec, on an undetermined Friday evening in September 2017. Jessica was picked up in a dark vehicle driven by an unknown person and has not been seen since. She was only reported missing to the police in March 2018. Jessica was known for living a high-risk lifestyle and she had previously expressed her intent to relocate to Ontario and earn money.

Hair: Blonde, Blonde hair, sometimes dyed red

Case reference: 2005001799.CaseDesc: On June 1, 1975, the body of an older adult female was located on the west bank of the Niagara River, in the town of Niagara-on-the-Lake. She is believed to be the same person who was witnessed jumping into the Horseshoe Falls on February 17, 1975. She is thought to be 40 plus years, short and heavy-set, with brown hair. She suffered from lung disease and had severe arthritis of her lumbar spine, which may have been painful. When witnessed going over the Falls, she was wearing a long overcoat, possibly grey, and carrying a green umbrella. There is no confirmation that the jumper and the deceased are the same person, however the general descriptions are in agreement. The condition of her remains suggest that she had been in the water for weeks to months.

Teeth: This female probably had a partial dental plate and still retained a gold crown on her right upper canine tooth.

Case reference: 2025015368.CaseDesc: On July 30, 1966, the body of a burned man was found north of 18th street in Val-d'Or, Abitibi, Quebec.  A lighter was found near the body and a metal belt buckle was associated with the body.

Leggings: Lighter, found next to belt buckle

Case reference: 2014019687.CaseDesc: On November 23, 2013, an unidentified partial male skull was found in a forested area along a power line in Anmore near Coquitlam, BC. The decedent has likely been missing for several years.

Deformity: Head, Fractured facial bones. Underwent surgery to his skull, possibly during the 1980s or 1990s

Case reference: 2014002337.CaseDesc: Timothy Peifer was last seen during the long weekend in September 2002 in the Caddy Lake area of Manitoba.  Timothy's whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2020007336.CaseDesc: On December 16, 1970, Abraham Wolfson was seen for the last time leaving a law office in Toronto, Ontario. Abraham had left with certificates worth $50,000 and had come into the city to arrange the sale of a property. Despite the offer of a reward from Abraham’s family, there has been no information pertaining to his whereabouts.

Case reference: 2019053661.CaseDesc:
On July 2, 1988, an unidentified man was found in the parking lot of the Value Village
on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, British Columbia. The man had suffered from a
heart attack, and the results of his autopsy showed evidence of previous heart damage and a case of mild chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

Case reference: 2014004566.CaseDesc: On September 14, 1981, at approximately 5:00pm, Dennis Krioul was last seen in Toronto, Ontario. Dennis’ wife states that he was in some business trouble and he had a warrant out for his arrest for fraud.

Case reference: 2025052599.CaseDesc: Treshaun Thompson left his home in Victoria, British Columbia, in the evening of September 9, 2025. Treshaun has not been in communication with his family since then and his current whereabouts are unknown.

Sweater: Hoodie with stylized script on back, dark colour

Case reference: 2014004296.CaseDesc: On November 20, 2002, Lowell Flett was reported missing by his employer as he had failed to show up for work for the 5th day. Lowell was last seen by his girlfriend, on November 16th. He left the residence on his ski-doo and has not been seen since. Despite intensive land and water searches neither Lowell nor his ski-doo have been located. He is presumed to have drowned as a result of his sled falling through the ice.

Case reference: 2013000047.CaseDesc: On August 11, 2000, Gianfranco Ferrara was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. He had an appointment in the east end of Montreal but he never showed up.

Case reference: 2014003232.CaseDesc: Warren Grundy was reported missing from Edmonton, Alberta, in June 1983. Warren's personal identification and clothing were later found near the North Saskatchewan river bank below the High Level Bridge in Edmonton. Warren may have been sighted in Ontario two and a half years after he disappeared. There was also suggestion that he may have travelled to Ohio, USA.

Case reference: 2019068654.CaseDesc: On November 16, 2019, Lara Parkin was seen for the last time in the South-West District of Montreal, Quebec. Lara is known to frequent Montreal’s downtown area and parks. She is also known to travel by foot or by public transit. During the time of her disappearance, Lara left her apartment without bringing any of her belongings.

Case reference: 2014005245.CaseDesc: Ka Hung Mok, was last seen by a family member around June 15, 1995 in Lasalle, Québec. He left the family home alone by car. The family later discovered that the vehicle had returned to the driveway, but Ka Hung was not seen and has not been heard from since.

Case reference: 2014002176.CaseDesc: On the evening of September 30, 1997, Michelle McGillion was seen for the last time in Fort McMurray, Alberta. During the time of her disappearance, Michelle was living a high-risk lifestyle and may have been despondent. She has ties to Alberta, Yukon, and Ontario where her family resides.

Case reference: 2018069999.CaseDesc: Jordan Nahachick, from the Simon Lake, Alberta area, was reported missing to police on December 21, 2018 and was last seen leaving Peace River Hospital in the afternoon hours of December 10, 2018. Police and his family are continuing their efforts to locate Jordan out of concern for his safety and well-being.

Case reference: 2014005450.CaseDesc: On June 6, 1979, James Gordon Nevin left his home in Amherstburg, Ontario, for a two-week vacation to visit relatives. He had a grandson in Winnipeg, Manitoba and a son in Prince George, British Columbia. The relatives were not informed of his planned visit.   On June 14, 1979, the RCMP responded to a call and located his 1974 white/maroon Dodge Coronet in a ditch between Rocanville, Saskatchewan and St. Lazare, Manitoba. Investigative findings indicate that the vehicle has been at this location since June 8, 1979.  James' whereabouts are currently unknown and it is believed that he was last seen between 1:30 p.m. and 3:00 p.m. on June 8, 1979. Extensive land and air searches have been conducted, all with negative results. The possibility of foul play cannot be discounted.

Scar: Right Thumb, Skin graft scar on right or left thumb

Case reference: 2014003895.CaseDesc: On April 30, 1993, the RCMP were informed that Diana Thomas had fallen through the ice and not resurfaced. She was a passenger on a snowmobile with her mother and a 13-year-old driver. The trio was about 10 metres from shore on Gods River, Shamattawa, Manitoba, when the snowmobile broke through the ice. Despite attempts to recover her, these met with negative results.

Case reference: 2014002843.CaseDesc: A party of 6 men departed Churchill, Manitoba, on a fishing trip traveling in three canoes. On June 20, 1967, two of the three canoes became stranded on mud flats at a point where the Hayes and Nelson Rivers empty into the Hudson Bay. The men made camp for the night and then the following day Kurt Hild, Ronald Davidson and James Cochrane all attempted to retrieve the stranded canoes. On return to the camp the men were confronted with high winds and freezing rain which forced them out of sight. None of the remains of the men have been recovered. Foul play is not suspected in the matter.

Case reference: 2014005610.CaseDesc: Roman Drag was last seen in the early hours of May 23, 2011 fishing at the top of the Bassano Dam in Bassano, AB. Case reference: 2014003215.CaseDesc: On June 24, 1972, a group of seven people, including Hank Ethier, were fishing on the Burntwood River. Late in the day the group and their two boats went to shore for supper. One group, which included Hank, left the shore. They were however unable to get their boat started and as a result they began to drift backwards towards the rapids. This group called for help and the other boat went to their aid. Hank jumped from his boat and swam to the second one. Once they reached the disabled boat everyone was told to get in. Both boats encountered the rapids. It is assumed Hank drowned as a result of the mishap.

Case reference: 2014005439.CaseDesc: John Sparrow was last seen in April or May of 2001, getting into an early 1990s black Chevrolet pick-up truck while accompanied by an unknown male driver. Case reference: 2014005302.CaseDesc: On November 11, 2005, in Toronto, Canada, Zaina Trujillo-Talib was abducted by her father, Chaudhry Talib and her paternal grandmother, Shama Talib. Case reference: 2014030834.CaseDesc: On May 28, 1967 at approximately 9:00 a.m. John Pawloski, his common-law wife and a young boy (9 years old) were fishing in the area of Pointe du Bois, Manitoba. John's fishing rod started to slip into the water and he ran to reach at it. He fell into the fast moving water. His wife attempted to rescue him, but she too slipped on the rocks and fell into the water. The young boy ran to get help and when he looked back he could no longer see the couple.  The body of John's wife was found down the river shortly after the incident. Searches for John's body were done by air, land and water but the body was never found. He is presumed to have drowned.
